sentences.l2: 在许多城市家庭里，孩子的课外活动正悄然变化。
sentences.l1: In many urban families, children's extracurricular activities are quietly changing.

sentences.l2: 过去，钢琴考级常被视为进入兴趣班的首要目标，家长希望孩子通过证书证明努力，也在同伴竞争中抢占起跑线。
sentences.l1: In the past, piano grade exams were often regarded as the primary goal of entering hobby classes, and parents hoped their children would prove their effort through certificates and also gain a head start in competition with peers.

sentences.l2: 如今，越来越多的父母开始重视素质教育，希望孩子不只掌握一项技能，还能培养创造力、合作能力和解决问题的能力。
sentences.l1: Nowadays, more and more parents are beginning to value quality education, hoping that their children will not only master one skill but also develop creativity, cooperation, and problem-solving abilities.

sentences.l2: 于是，编程夏令营逐渐受到欢迎。
sentences.l1: So coding summer camps are gradually becoming popular.

sentences.l2: 孩子们在营地中学习图形化编程或简单的算法，用代码完成动画、游戏和小型项目。
sentences.l1: At camp, children learn graphical programming or simple algorithms, and use code to complete animations, games, and small projects.

sentences.l2: 这样的安排看似轻松，其实也承载着家庭对未来的期待：既希望孩子拥有扎实的学业基础，又担心他们在起跑线上落后。
sentences.l1: Such an arrangement seems relaxed, but in fact it also carries the family's expectations for the future: they hope the child will have a solid academic foundation, yet worry that they will fall behind at the starting line.

sentences.l2: 因此，选择兴趣班不再只是艺术训练，而成为家庭教育理念、资源投入和升学规划的综合体现。
sentences.l1: Therefore, choosing a hobby class is no longer just artistic training, but becomes a comprehensive reflection of a family's educational philosophy, resource investment, and plans for further schooling.
